headline: Requests on truck traffic on Weston Avenue, residential parking permit fees, and temporary parking permits during city construction.
summary: Councilors ask the police chief for an update on a road safety grant program. Other items ask the parking director for free temporary permits and a study of vehicle size in permit fees, and the mobility director to discuss truck safety on Weston Avenue.
items: Police chief update on the Municipal Road Safety Grant Program
Free temporary parking permits for residents whose driveways are blocked by city construction
Mobility director discussion of safety concerns from large trucks cutting through Weston Avenue
Vehicle size and weight in residential parking permit fees

2. Resolution

- That Chief of Police provide an update to this Council

3. Resolution

Sent for Discussion: By Councilor Link and Councilor

- That the Director of Parking issue free temporary parking

Traffic and Parking Committee

Regular Meeting Agenda

December 7, 2026

4. Resolution

Sent for Discussion: By Councilor Hardt, Councilor

(ID # 26-1430 ) Strezo and Councilor Link

- That the Director of Mobility discuss with this Council

possible strategies to address safety concerns caused by large trucks using Weston Avenue as a cut-through from

Broadway to Clarendon Avenue, particularly the dangerous conditions created when these trucks make a

- right turn from Weston Avenue onto Clarendon Avenue.

5. Order

Sent for Discussion: By Councilor Wheeler

(ID # 26-1420 ) That the Director of Parking discuss with this Council

- the feasibility of considering vehicle size and weight

when establishing residential parking permit fees, so that permit costs may better reflect the amount of parking

space used and the relative impact of different sized vehicles on city streets.
